newsitem.title: USA: American Homestar sees $2.6 mln Q1 charge.
newsitem.headline: American Homestar sees $2.6 mln Q1 charge.

text.p: American Homestar Corp said Tuesday it expects to record a one-time charge of $2.6 million in its fiscal 1998 first quarter as a result of its purchase of Brilliant Holding Corp.

The company said the deal, which closed Tuesday, will be slightly accretive to 1998 earnings. The First Call consensus estimate for the company's first quarter 1998 is $0.52 per share versus $0.27 in 1997, and the estimate for fiscal 1998 is $1.58 versus an estimate of $1.29 for fiscal 1997.

The transaction with Brilliant Holdings, a maker of manufactured homes, involved the transfer of 500,000 American Homestar shares and the assumption of $9 million in funded debt. It will be accounted for as a pooling of interests.

American Homestar operates 11 manufactured home plants and 54 retail outlets and serves another 400 independent retail outlets in 26 states, it said. Brilliant Holdings had three plants in Alabama, and markets its products in 12 states in the Southeast.
